name: testsurfer
description: End-to-end testing for the web, driven by vibesurfer. Playwright-style locators and auto-retrying assertions over a real WebKit engine with trusted native input.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-injected.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/devices.json dist/devices.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/wire.test.ts test/tree.test.ts test/selector.test.ts test/aria.test.ts test/png.test.ts test/values.test.ts test/pwconfig.test.ts test/injected.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: node --test test/e2e.test.ts test/features.test.ts test/locators.test.ts test/config.test.ts test/network.test.ts test/screenshot.test.ts test/runner.test.ts && cd test/projects && node ../../src/cli.ts test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit
